questions.question: As of 2019, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin, aims to achieve "Housing for All" by:
questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct, i.e. __**2022**__.

__
 
• Union Government aims to achieve the objective of Housing for All by **2022__** under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Grameen.
 
• A total of over 1 crore 50 lakh rural houses have been completed in the last five years.
 
• The eligible beneficiaries will get 1 crore 95 lakh houses in the second phase of the scheme. The government has set a target of 60 lakh houses for the current financial year.
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana- Gramin (PMAY-G) has been devised in line with the Government’s commitment to providing ‘Housing for All’ by 2022 in the rural areas.
 
• The scheme aims at providing a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless householder living in kutcha and dilapidated houses by 2022.

questions.question: Lala Lajpat Rai was the founder of which of the following bank?
questions.solution:
Option **3** is correct, i.e. __**Punjab National Bank**__.

• Punjab National Bank is presently headquartered in New Delhi.

**Note:**

 
• Lala Lajpat Rai is popularly known as 'Punjab Kesari'.
 
• He was an Indian freedom fighter and founder of the Home Rule League in British India.
 
• He played a pivotal role in India's Freedom struggle and he succumbed to death while protesting against Simon Commission.

questions.question: Which of the following Acts was also known as Montague-Chelmsford Reform?

• In 1918, **Edwin Montagu**, the Secretary of State, and **Lord Chelmsford**, the Viceroy, produced their scheme of constitutional reforms which led to the enactment of the **Government of India Act of 1919**.
 
• The Provincial Legislative Councils were enlarged and the majority of their members were to be elected. 
 
• The provincial governments were given more powers under the** system of Dyarchy**.
 
• Under this system, the various subjects of the government were divided under reserved and transferred.

questions.question: In 12th Century Karnataka, Virashaivas were the followers of ______.
questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e. __**Basavanna**__.

 
• The twelfth-century witnessed the emergence of a new movement in Karnataka, led by a Brahmana named **Basavanna** (1106-68) who was initially a Jain and a minister in the court of a Chalukya king.
 
• His followers were known as **Virashaivas** (heroes of Shiva) or **Lingayats** (wearers of the linga). 
 
• The movement focused on the annihilation of caste-based and gender-based inequality in society.

questions.question: How many powerful Mahajanapadas existed in ancient India?
questions.solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e. **__16__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total 16 Mahajanapadas are -** Kashi, Kosala, Anga, Magadha, Vajji, Malla, Chedi, Vatsa, Kuru, Panchala, Machcha, Surasena, Assaka, Avanti, Gandhara and Kamboja**.
 
• Anguattara Nikaya, a text of Buddhist Literature gives a list of 16 kingdoms called Mahajanapadas.
 
• These Mahajanpadas are either Monarchy or a Republics (Ganasanghas).
 
• The important Republics of this period were the Sakyas of Kapilavastu and the Licchavis of Vaishali.
 
• The important monarchical Mahajanpadas of this period were Kaushambi (Vatsa), Magadha, Kosala, and Avanti.

questions.question: How many amendments are there in Indian Constitution till March 2019?
questions.solution:
Option **4** is correct, i.e. __**103**__.

__
 
• Stated in **Part XX** of the Indian Constitution, **Article 368** grants power to the Parliament to amend the Constitution and also asserts the procedure that needs to be followed in order to amend the Constitution.
 
• As of now, there are 448 articles in 25 parts, **103 amendments**__, 5 appendices, and 12 schedules are there in the Indian Constitution.
 
• When it was first made, it had 395 articles in 22 parts and 8 schedules in it, thus being the world’s lengthiest written constitution.

questions.question: Which of the following element is present in an antiperspirant deodorant?
questions.solution:
**__Aluminium__**

 
• Antiperspirant is a liquid/gel that is used to reduce sweating and perspiration.
 
• The Aluminium-based compounds are used because these compound form a temporary plug within the sweat duct that stops flow of sweat.
 
• When the Aluminium comes in contact with sweat it turns into a gel that forms plug over sweat gland.
 
• sweat is still produced in our body but it won't be released in the areas where antiperspirant has been applied.
 
• When an antiperspirant is applied, the salt dissolves the sweat or moisture in the underarm.

questions.question: In the year 1817 ______ tried to arrange elements with similar properties into groups.
questions.solution:
__**Dobereiner**__

 
• In 1817, a German chemist Johann Wolfgang Dobereiner arranged the elements with similar properties in a group. 
 
• Dobereiner Triad is based on three elements group. He was the first person who started grouping of elements on the basis of atomic weight.
 
• The three elements of the triad were arranged in such a manner that the atomic mass of the middle element was approximately the average of the atomic masses of the other two elements.
 
• For example:- Atomic weight of Li=7, Na=23, K=39&n
